title: Plasmo Voice Collection
description: Plasmo Voice Collection brings together the Plasmo Voice ecosystem into a single modpack with proximity voice chat, addons, extensions, and All Plasmo Voice Connections, also known as Plasmo Voice Plus and Plasmo Voice + for search purposes.｜By: ErikrafT
body:
![Wallpaper Plasmo Voice](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec3772a332603294fae6d12d57ee516b7707daab.png) # Plasmo Voice Collection Plasmo Voice Collection is a modpack for Minecraft Java Edition that brings together the complete Plasmo Voice ecosystem in a single installation. The collection is available for **Fabric**, **Forge**, and **NeoForge**, supporting both **Minecraft 1.21** and **Minecraft 26.2** (where available). It includes Plasmo Voice alongside official addons, compatibility modules, and immersive audio enhancements designed to improve proximity voice chat, multiplayer communication, and roleplay experiences. ## Features * Proximity voice chat with Plasmo Voice * Voice Messages support * Whisper, Priority, Spectator, and Nickname addons * Sound Physics integration * Talking Heads integration *(Fabric & NeoForge)* * ReplayMod integration *(Fabric 1.21)* * Soundboard support *(Fabric 1.21)* * Voice Changer support *(Fabric only)* * Volume Booster support *(Fabric 1.21)* * Customizable Player Models compatibility *(1.21 releases)* * Client and server support * All Plasmo Voice Connections in one modpack ## Available Versions | Minecraft | Fabric | Forge | NeoForge | | --------- | :----: | :---: | :------: | | **1.21** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **26.2** | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ## Included Content Depending on the selected version and mod loader, the collection may include: * Plasmo Voice * Voice Messages * Voice Changer * Soundboard * Volume Booster * Whisper * Priority * Spectator * Nickname * ReplayMod integration * Sound Physics * Talking Heads * Customizable Player Models compatibility * LavaPlayer library for supported addons Each release is optimized for its respective Minecraft version and mod loader while maintaining the same goal: delivering **All Plasmo Voice Connections** in one easy-to-install modpack. ## Compatibility * Minecraft Java Edition * Minecraft 1.21 and 26.2 * Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge * Client and Server The **Plasmo Voice Collection**, also known as **Plasmo Voice Plus**, **Plasmo Voice +**, and **All Plasmo Voice Connections**, offers an easy way to discover and install the entire Plasmo Voice ecosystem. --- ## Official Merch╺╸(ErikrafT) Support the creator by checking out official merchandise inspired by ErikrafT: [![Official ErikrafT Merchandise Collection](https://www.erikraft.com/img/Wallpaper-Card_Loja_ErikrafT.jpeg)](https://www.erikraft.com/loja.html)

Official and partner-made apparel for fans across Brazil, including exclusive designs. --- ## Content Creation / Credit If you create videos (for example on YouTube) using this modpack, please credit the creator and include the modpack link in the description: [https://modrinth.com/modpack/plasmo-voice-collection](https://modrinth.com/modpack/plasmo-voice-collection) --- ![Credits Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/296181467b54345c16b0c6640652feed22f21e34.png) Created by a Brazilian Minecraft content creator named ErikrafT: * Website: [www.erikraft.com](https://www.erikraft.com) --- ![Our Other Projects Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75f4d3d7ff72b1febef0e974e8808fea8083af79.png) - [MC++](https://modrinth.com/modpack/mc-plus-by-erikraft) - [All Things Possible [OUTDATED]](https://modrinth.com/mod/all-things-possible)
